scenario.title: Time order reversal
scenario.description: Validation starts before the train time window ends.

knownBiases: All labels are generated by a deterministic synthetic SIL oracle.
Only the X residual head is eligible for validation in this slice.
coverageGaps: No real-device paired holdout is included.
Y and Z have no validated improvement; B and C have insufficient excitation.
